name: SamuelEpa/turo-scraper
what_it_holds: Small, unstarred scraper of Turo (peer-to-peer car rental) listings/prices. Two near-identical sibling repos exist (ConnerZhao/turo-scraper, jacob-petterle/turo-scraper), all low-activity personal projects, no committed data.
why_useful: Turo is a same-sharing-economy, same-regulatory-fight adjacent marketplace (car rental instead of lodging); a listing-density/price scraper here could in principle proxy local leisure-travel intensity in a market the way STR listing density does, and Turo faces parallel airport/city ordinance fights that sometimes bundle with STR rules. Weak: no maintained repo, no data files, thin evidence this reads on Airbnb KPIs.

name: clemred/Getaround-api
what_it_holds: One of several near-identical student bootcamp (Jedha-style) projects using a fixed, small Getaround (European car-sharing) rental-delay/pricing CSV dataset for an ML price-prediction exercise. Several forks/clones exist (YoussefMrbt/Getaround_api, tryph0n/getaround_api, Rodelinexavier/GETAROUNDML_API, loft897/getaround-api) all sharing the same underlying dataset.
why_useful: Getaround is a European car-sharing marketplace; a committed dataset of rental durations/delays/pricing is a genuine data file (not just a method), but it is a fixed teaching snapshot (small, dated, no update cadence) rather than a live or point-in-time series — thin value.

name: DOT BTS on-time-performance derivative projects (multiple)
what_it_holds: Several student/analyst projects hold static extracts of the US DOT BTS On-Time Performance dataset (millions of US domestic flights, airline, airport, delay cause, cancellation flag) -- one explicitly 6.2M+ flights/14 airlines/628 airports, another 745K flights with weather features.
why_useful: Flight cancellation/delay rates by airport and date (especially around storms/strikes) are a plausible leading proxy for travel disruption that could depress or reschedule STR bookings in the same markets/weeks -- gap #10 explicitly names BTS T-100/DB1B; these repos hold ready-cleaned subsets that avoid a fresh BTS pull, though none appear point-in-time or updated live.

time_coverage: varies by project, generally recent historical years, static snapshot
